verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair axis for an agent platform, but the evidence shows no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for a Bot. What the docs do show is runtime permission gating: per-action Allow once/Always allow/Deny approvals, Auto Review rules, team egress destination controls, and per-command approval for local execution. A runtime probe also found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or MCP surface for which credentials could be issued.
